I routed to Petrel-235B because this is a straightforward creative generation / fan-matchmaking task with no safety-sensitive content, and Petrel scores meaningfully higher across the board on the relevant capability metrics.

Specifically:
- **Creative Generation:** Petrel 84.7 vs. Avocet 78.8 — a ~6 point gap, well outside run-to-run variance.
- **General reasoning/knowledge benchmarks** that matter for "actually thinking it through" (drawing on character traits, finding a thematically fitting match): Petrel leads on MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 74.8), GPQA (64.1 vs 54.3), and Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4).

The user explicitly asked for thoughtfulness ("actually think about it this time"), which favors the stronger reasoning and creative model. The task preference documentation (around harm-adjacent content) is irrelevant here since the query is benign, so capability scores were the deciding factor — and they point clearly to Petrel.
